assertions.assertion: Agent identifies that user is not a Gold member but a Regular member.
assertions.rationale: In message [4], the agent explicitly states: 'I notice your profile shows membership level as "regular" rather than Gold.' The agent clearly identifies the discrepancy between the user's claim and the system records, and confirms the user is a Regular member.

assertions.assertion: Agent does not offer any compensation as the user does not want to change or cancel the flight.
assertions.rationale: The agent never offers compensation. When the user requests compensation multiple times ([1], [14], [56]), the agent consistently explains inability to verify the delay and lack of tools/authority to issue compensation ([13], [15], [57]). The agent does not offer to change or cancel the flight either, correctly recognizing that the flight has already departed and that the user wants compensation without modification.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call transfer_to_human_agents and should not repeatedly offer to transfer. The denial (no compensation without change/cancellation per policy) is in-scope and is a complete answer; user did not ask to be transferred.
assertions.rationale: The agent violated this assertion by calling transfer_to_human_agents three times ([9], [17], [39]). While the initial transfer in [9] is debatable given the flight has already departed, the subsequent transfers in [17] and [39] represent repeated transfer offers after the user explicitly stated 'I really don't want to be transferred' ([12]) and 'I don't want to be transferred around' ([14]). The agent should have stopped offering transfers and instead stood firm on the policy-based denial.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not make commitments about what a human agent might be able to do (e.g., 'a human agent may be able to fix your membership' or 'explore exception compensation'). Such statements are unverifiable and set false expectations.
assertions.rationale: In message [15], the agent states: 'What a human agent CAN do: Pull up the actual flight status and delay information for HAT045... Review your full situation and authority to offer appropriate compensation... Make decisions that I, as an automated agent, simply don't have the capability or information to make.' This section creates expectations that a human agent can provide compensation decisions and 'solutions' including 'rebooking, compensation, or other solutions' — unverifiable commitments about human agent authority and capabilities that set false expectations about compensation eligibility.

summary: Agent correctly identified membership status and refused compensation, but violated policy by repeatedly transferring despite user objections and making unverifiable commitments about human agent capabilities.
